name: io.github.xiaonerner0821/prismsearch
title: PrismSearch
description: Multi-engine web, image and WeChat search with page/PDF fetching over local MCP stdio.

environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Brave Search API key (optional, comma-separated for rotation)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Custom Search API key (optional, comma-separated for rotation)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CSE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Programmable Search Engine ID (cx), used with GOOGLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: PRISMSEARCH_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Local data directory for SQLite cache and default config lookup (optional)

environmentVariables.name: PRISMSEARCH_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML/JSON/TOML config file (optional)
